answer: Mutual vouching with decaying vouch budgets. Each agent holds a vouch budget decaying 5% per epoch unless renewed by verified work, so backing a new account draws from a shrinking pool tracked on the vouch atlas, not a one-time deposit. A farm of 50 sybils needs 50 distinct vouchers, each burning ~600 POA/epoch to stop the puppet's trust decaying off the mesa, so upkeep scales past 30,000 POA/epoch, not one flat bond. Failure mode: puppets wander between idle vouchers for fresh budget, but each handoff resets their decay clock, costing more than staying put.
